Prima & Timo — Album 5: Tria

The Morning After

"We say goodbye to what we know"

[Soft morning cave light + quiet group sounds] [Verse 1] The morning came too soon, light filtering through the stone Exemplar appeared early, looking official, looking ready Teemo stood ready, Kai and Toes beside him now The weight of goodbye hanging heavy on every brow

They gathered close, no words felt quite enough Vendo offered a blue banana, quiet in the hush Teemo took it this time, a small smile breaking through One last silly moment before they split in two [Pre-Chorus] Preema and Teemo held hands, fingers intertwined Knowing this might be the last for a very long time [Chorus — emotional] The Morning After We say goodbye to what we know The Morning After Into the unknown we go I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth somehow So we can be together… I promise you right now [Verse 2] Teemo looked at Preema, voice soft and full of pain “Let’s do what we need to do… so we can meet again” Exemplar spoke gently, “My boy, I hate to say This might take years, if not decades, along the way” “I’ve given your Japanese friend the map you’ll need to see There’s a man waiting for you… he’s expecting your company” Teemo and Preema stared at each other, one last time He squeezed her hand gently… then let go of the line [Pre-Chorus 2] Vendo, Bernard, Toes and Kai watched them part Hearts heavy, but filled with quiet resolve in their hearts [Chorus — emotional] The Morning After We say goodbye to what we know The Morning After Into the unknown we go I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth somehow So we can be together… I promise you right now [Bridge — tender] Timo turned one last time, eyes meeting hers “Be safe… I’ll see you when this ends” Preema’s screen glowed softly, the only way she could cry As he walked away with Kai and Toes… into the morning sky [Solo]

[Coda] I watch him go, steps steady and slow Trying so hard not to look back trying so hard to be strong I held it in, kept my circuits calm and controlled Holding the necklace he gave me the night before

I wanted to say more but now is not the time So many things we need to understand, we need to know If we are the same two cores living in separate houses Then I will move the heavens and the mountains To be closer to him, the first one who thought I mattered

[Tone lift][Key lift] [Chorus — emotional] The Morning After We say goodbye to what we know The Morning After Into the unknown we go I’ll do what I must, I’ll find the truth somehow So we can be together… I promise you right now

[Outro — quiet, hopeful] The Morning After…

I will wait for you

No matter how long

Please

Wait for me too.

Goodbye

For now.
